title: Hull and Boundary
subtitle: The walls nobody gets through
text:
Hull blocks and the Hull Boundary cannot be broken in survival, by explosions, the Wither or the Ender Dragon. Creative players can place and break them, so they are for map makers and ship structures. There is no survival recipe.

Hull Glass is the see-through version. Use it for the big bridge windows. Windows and hull glass join up with their own kind: a wall of them is one sheet with a frame only round the outside.

Plating, panels, grates, windows, lights and portholes come in three finishes: Ancient, Industrial and Clean. Make the plating, then cut it into the other shapes on a stonecutter.
